fact_text: Hub Power is part of a consortium with Lucky Cement, Kohat Cement and Metro that is bidding for PIA, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The PIA holding consortium had grown to about five parties by July 2025, and the bidding was for a 51% stake in the airline.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The analyst saw Fauji Fertilizer as a front-runner in the PIA deal, and suggested it could bid with funds raised by moving shares to Fauji Foundation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The analyst said a PIA bid would probably not change Fauji Fertilizer's dividend stream much, and a Shariah-compliance restructuring could involve share transfers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: PSO's receivables were about PKR 450 billion in its reported nine-month balance sheet, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The analyst expected the settlement of circular-debt payments to reduce PSO's receivables, improving its balance sheet and cash position.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The analyst expected the government to settle payment claims from Chinese power producers, which he said could be adjusted at the negotiating table.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The analyst said OMC margins were rising, which he called favourable for oil marketing companies, and noted that foreign investment in Pakistan's oil sector had mostly gone to OMCs.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: OMC volume handling was strong in 2021-22, then weakened when Pakistan defended its current account, and the analyst said it was starting to improve again.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: Pakistan's current account improved in the months before 9 July 2025, with a small surplus in some of those months, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)

fact_text: The analyst said fuel for telecom towers, which run on generators, is supplied through OMCs and their pump owners, adding to OMC business volume.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 09 July 2025 | HUBC Joins PIA Bidding | PSO, FFC, Fauji Group & OMC Stocks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-07-09)
